source_title: Exclusive Mopar '27 Dodge Charger Commemorates 90 Years of Mopar Passion, Performance and Personalization at SEMA Show - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
AUBURN HILLS, Mich. , Oct. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ --
Annual limited-production drop from Mopar celebrates the brand's 90th anniversary and combines unique styling, carbon-fiber details and functional performance enhancements to the all-wheel-drive Dodge muscle car
Fourth time Dodge Charger has been given a full Mopar treatment since 2011
Available on two two-door models: SIXPACK-powered 420-horsepower Charger R/T and 550-horsepower Charger Scat Pack Plus
U.S. MSRP for exclusive Mopar '27 Package is $10,995
Mopar '27 Dodge Charger will be joined by a wide array of customized vehicles from Dodge, JeepÂ® and Ram, plus hundreds of factory-backed performance parts and accessories from Mopar and Direct Connection, at the newly located Mopar booth (59119) in the West Hall at the Specialty Equipment Market Association (SEMA) Show in Las Vegas, Nov. 3-6
Mopar marks its 90th anniversary in 2027 with the introduction of the exclusive Mopar '27 Dodge Charger, a limited-edition package that blends distinctive Mopar styling, modern muscle-car attitude and factory-engineered personalization.
Mopar '27 will debut at the Mopar NHRA Las Vegas Nationals powered by Dodge Oct. 30-Nov.1 at Las Vegas Motor Speedway before taking center stage at the 2026 Specialty Equipment Market Association (SEMA) Show, Nov. 3-6. Mopar will move to a new location for the 2026 show: booth 59119 in the West Hall of the Las Vegas Convention Center.
Available on two-door 2027 Dodge Charger R/T and Dodge Charger Scat Pack Plus models, the Mopar '27 package will be limited to 270 units, with 90 vehicles offered in each of three exterior colors, Bludicrous, Diamond Black and White Knuckle, providing a nod to Mopar's 90-year heritage.
Dealer orders begin in early January 2027. Production will begin in spring 2027, and allocation will be split between 243 units for the U.S. market and 27 units for Canada.
"The Mopar '27 Dodge Charger showcases our passion for personalization and performance while celebrating nine decades of helping enthusiasts make their vehicles uniquely their own," said Darren Bradshaw, senior vice president, Stellantis parts and services - North America. "Our latest special-edition, limited-build package delivers exclusive styling, premium materials and signature Mopar touches that celebrate the passion, performance and personalization enthusiasts have come to expect from Mopar."
Exclusive Mopar '27 Content The Mopar '27 package enhances the Dodge Charger models with a collection of exclusive exterior, interior and performance features from Mopar, including:
Direct Connection carbon-fiber front splitter
Direct Connection carbon-fiber hood with functional scoop
Direct Connection carbon-fiber rear spoiler
Serialized Mopar '27 / Mopar 90th anniversary under-hood plaque mounted on the radiator closeout panel
Two Two-door Mopar '27 Charger Model Configurations The Mopar '27 Charger R/T model starts with the 2027 Dodge Charger R/T and adds the exclusive Mopar content package, delivering a more accessible entry point into the limited-edition program. Powered by the 420-horsepower, 3.0-liter, twin-turbo SIXPACK engine with standard all-wheel drive and an on-demand rear-wheel-drive mode, performance numbers include 0-60 mph acceleration in 4.6 seconds and running the quarter-mile in 12.9 seconds.
The Mopar '27 Scat Pack Plus combines leather performance seats, 20-by-11-inch wheels, Carbon and Suede Package and the Blacktop Package, creating the highest-contented Mopar '27 configuration available from the factory. Power output is raised to 550 horsepower from the 3.0-liter twin-turbo SIXPACK engine featuring fully forged internals, larger 54mm Garrett Twin turbos for increased boost and charge air cooler. With standard all-wheel drive and an on-demand rear-wheel-drive mode, performance numbers improve to 0-60 mph acceleration in 3.9 seconds and running the quarter-mile in 12.2 seconds.
The U.S. MSRP for the exclusive Mopar '27 Package is $10,995 for either Charger model.
More Performance From Direct Connection The Mopar '27 Dodge Charger show vehicle will also feature three additional factory-backed performance parts for the Dodge Charger for customers looking to further personalize their limited-edition muscle car.
These accessories are offered separately through authorized Dodge performance dealers and are not included as part of the Mopar '27 package:
High-performance cat-back exhaust for 3.0-liter Hurricane twin-turbo inline-six SIXPACK engine provides a richer exhaust (part number: 77073018AA)
Performance suspension spring kit for improved handling and stability (part number: 77073045AA)
21-by-11-inch Brass Monkey wheels (part number: 77073039AA)
Exclusive Mopar '27 Owner Kit Each buyer will receive a Mopar '27 owner kit that includes a personalized certificate of authenticity with serialized vehicle-build number, a special rendering of the vehicle by the Mopar design team and more.
Mopar Customization History The Mopar '27 Dodge Charger is the fourth Charger to be given the full Mopar treatment since 2011. It joins an exclusive club as the latest limited-edition, Mopar-modified vehicle delivered straight from the factory.
In 2010, Mopar produced the first of an ongoing series of limited-edition vehicles, the Mopar '10 Dodge Challenger. Other low-volume, factory-produced Mopar rides have followed:

Mopar Mopar is the global name for Stellantis genuine parts and authentic accessories.
Created in 1937 as the name of a line of antifreeze products and celebrating 90 years in 2027, Mopar supports vehicle owners worldwide with decades of expertise in customer care, service, parts, accessories and performance.
Mopar made its mark in the 1960s during the muscle-car era with performance parts to enhance speed and handling for both on-road and racing use. Later, Mopar expanded to include technical service and customer support in order to enhance customer and dealer support worldwide.
